key: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: Break up for you a fallow ground, And sow not among thorns.
s: After the plea to Israel to return, the LORD turns to Judah and Jerusalem in a farmer’s image; Rashi, on 4:3, reads it as learning from farmers who plough in summer to kill the roots, and mending deeds before evil comes, lest prayer be rejected.

evidence.gloss: For thus said the LORD, etc. Break up for you a fallow ground: learn from the tillers of the soil, who plough it in summer to kill the roots of the weeds, so that it brings up no thorns at sowing time in winter; you too, mend your deeds before the evil comes upon you, so that your prayer is not rejected when you cry out.
